instruction: Choose a suitable tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD to complete the task. For the steps below, launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to build and solve a 2D plane-stress plate model. Physical problem: A rectangular plate with a central circular hole is subjected to uniaxial tensile loading. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - The plate width is along the X direction. - The plate length is along the Y direction. - The plate occupies: - 0 ≤ X ≤ 100 mm - 0 ≤ Y ≤ 200 mm - Plate thickness: 1 mm - A circular hole is located at the plate center: - Hole center: (X, Y) = (50, 100) mm - Hole diameter: 10 mm - Hole radius: 5 mm Model parameters: - Material: linear elastic steel - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3 - Element type: appropriate two-dimensional plane-stress element formulation - Element behavior: plane stress with thickness option - Thickness: 1 mm - Mesh: - Global element size: 5 mm - Local element size around the circular hole: 1 mm Boundary conditions and load: - Apply uniform uniaxial tension in the X direction. - Apply a nominal tensile stress of 10 MPa on the left and right vertical edges: - On the left edge X = 0, apply traction in the -X direction. - On the right edge X = 100, apply traction in the +X direction. - Do not constrain the full top or bottom edges. - Apply only the minimum displacement constraints required to remove rigid-body motion, without altering the uniaxial tensile stress field. For example: - Fix UX = 0 and UY = 0 at one reference node. - Fix UY = 0 at a second reference node separated in the X direction. - The circular hole boundary must remain traction-free. Analysis type: - Static structural analysis. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
